ranking.note: model win probability 38.2% below the 40% confidence floor
expected value after shrinkage toward the market is only +0.8% (< 1%)
edge +0.8% below the 4% minimum (starting goalie unconfirmed)

evidence: log loss +0.0175 (95% interval +0.0030 to +0.0292). The model's probabilities are WORSE than the market's closing probabilities (the interval is above zero).

131 picks, ROI -0.2% (95% interval -16.0% to +13.2%), win rate 59.5% against a break-even 58.7%. Random sides at the same margin match or beat this 25% of the time. Line movement toward the pick after it was made: +0.07 probability points on average (zero means no closing-line value).
How many bets before ROI can be trusted

At the observed spread of results, detecting a true 3% ROI takes about 4,900 bets and a 5% ROI about 1,764; a 1% edge takes 44,100. Closing-line value converges much faster, which is why it is the primary measure.
21 picks, ROI -100.0% (-100.0% to -100.0%): too few picks (<30) to say anything.
